name: real-fabric-api-missing-journeymap
description: Fabric 1.20.4 server, JourneyMap installed without Fabric API (reported on a Docker server)
fix: Install the Fabric API jar: nothing pulls it in for you.

name: real-fabric-api-wrong-minecraft
description: Fabric 1.21.4 server with the Fabric API built for 1.21.5
fix: Download the Fabric API built for the Minecraft version you run.

name: real-jei-loader-too-old
description: Fabric 1.20.1 on Loader 0.15.11, JEI 15.17 needs 0.16.3
fix: Upgrade Fabric Loader to 0.16.3 or later.

name: real-modernfix-loader-too-old
description: Fabric 1.21.4 on Loader 0.16.9, ModernFix needs 0.16.10
fix: Run the Fabric installer again and pick loader 0.16.10 or later.

name: real-sodium-extra-on-server
description: NeoForge 1.21.1 server with Sodium Extra, a client mod, in its mods folder
fix: Take the client-only rendering mods out of the server's mods folder.

name: real-kotlin-language-provider-missing
description: NeoForge 1.21.1 server, a Kotlin mod without Kotlin for Forge
fix: Install the Kotlin for Forge language provider the mod asks for.

name: real-plugin-missing-vault
description: Paper 1.19.3, AnnouncerPlus 1.3.4 without Vault
fix: Install the plugin it names (Vault): a hard dependency must be there before it loads.

name: real-plugin-api-too-new
description: Paper 1.20.6 with a plugin that declares a newer api-version
fix: Run a server at least as recent as the plugin's api-version, or take an older build of the plugin.

name: real-paper-needs-java21
description: Paper 1.20.6 started with Java 17
fix: Run Minecraft 1.20.5 and later with Java 21.

name: real-folia-plugin-unsupported
description: Folia 1.20.2 with InvSee++ 0.24.6, which does not say it supports Folia
fix: Only plugins whose plugin.yml says folia-supported: true load on Folia; ask the author or run Paper.

name: real-protocollib-too-old
description: Paper 1.21.5 with ProtocolLib 5.2.0, released before that Minecraft version
fix: Update ProtocolLib: it reads the server's packet registry, which changes with every Minecraft version.

name: real-viaversion-warning-only
description: Paper 1.21.1 with ViaVersion, which warns loudly but breaks nothing
fix: Nothing to fix: ViaVersion only lets newer clients in; older ones need ViaBackwards.

name: plugins-built-for-java25
description: Paper 1.21.8 on Java 21 with today's WorldEdit, WorldGuard and BentoBox, all built for Java 25
source: lab, 22/09/2026: the current builds of these plugins are compiled for Java 25 (class file 69)
fix: Run the server with the Java version the plugins were built for, or take an older build of the plugin.

name: real-densefuel-language-provider-pinned
description: NeoForge 21.1.236 with DenseFuel, which asks for javafml 4.0.42 exactly
fix: Stay below NeoForge 21.1.235, or the mod must widen the javafml range it asks for.

name: real-world-not-writable
description: Paper 1.21.1 whose world folder the server may no longer read (wrong owner in a container)
fix: Give the folder to the user the server runs as (chown), or set the container's UID and GID to the owner's.

name: real-corrupt-server-jar
description: Vanilla 1.21.1 whose server.jar was cut short by a failed download
fix: Delete the jar and download it again: the file is incomplete.

name: real-rcon-port-taken
description: Paper 1.21.1 with RCON told to use the port the game already listens on
fix: Give RCON a port of its own, different from server-port.

name: real-level-type-legacy
description: Paper 1.21.1 with the old level-type 'default', which it only warns about
fix: Nothing breaks: since 22w12a the value is minecraft:normal, and anything else falls back to it.

name: real-broken-version-range-in-metadata
description: NeoForge 1.21.1, TenshiLib 2.3.0 whose metadata holds an impossible version range
fix: Take the rebuilt jar (2.3.0.b): the range in its metadata was written wrong.

name: real-library-too-old-for-bundle
description: NeoForge 1.21.1, Serilum bundles that want Collective 8.4 with 8.3 installed
fix: Install Collective 8.4, or go back to the bundle built for 8.3.

name: real-forge-jar-in-neoforge
description: NeoForge 1.21.1 server with a Forge jar (Collective for 1.20.1), silently skipped
source: lab, 22/09/2026: NeoForge says the jar is for Forge or an older NeoForge and skips it, without stopping
fix: Install the build made for this loader and this Minecraft version; the mod is simply not loaded.

name: real-connector-transform-failure
description: NeoForge 1.21.1 with Sinytra Connector beta.10, the Forgified Fabric API and Axiom
fix: Move to a later Connector build: this one cannot read that mod's mixin settings.

name: real-midnightlib-metadata-broken
description: NeoForge 26.3 with MidnightLib 1.9.3, published with a version range the loader cannot read
fix: Take 1.9.3.1: the range in the published jar was written wrong.

name: paper-lag-recent
description: Paper 1.21.11, a plugin eats 70 ms of every tick: this Paper says nothing at all
source: lab, 22/09/2026: checking whether recent Paper still writes 'Can't keep up!'
fix: Nothing is written down any more: take a spark profile while it is slow.

name: paper-lag-recent-spark
description: Paper 1.21.11, the same slow plugin, found through a spark profile
source: lab, 22/09/2026: the way to see a slow tick now that the log says nothing
fix: Read the spark profile: it names what eats the tick.

name: real-bluemap-eventbus7
description: Forge 1.21.9 with BlueMap 5.12, whose listener EventBus 7 no longer accepts
fix: Update BlueMap past 5.12: Forge EventBus 7 refuses its old listener.

name: real-plugin-api-too-new-26
description: Paper 26.1.2 with a plugin that declares api-version 26.2
fix: Run a server at least as recent as the plugin's api-version, or take the build made for yours.

name: real-block-entity-tick-crash-mods
description: NeoForge 1.21.11, Tom's Storage 2.8.0 with a Sophisticated Core that no longer has the class it calls
fix: Update Tom's Storage to 2.8.1, or go back to the Sophisticated Core it was built against.

name: real-entity-pileup-lag
description: Paper 1.20.4 on one core with a crowd of chickens in one chunk, as in a forum report
fix: Remove the crowd of entities (or the world holding it): chunks keep ticking even with nobody there.

name: real-sodium-on-server
description: NeoForge 1.21.1 server with Sodium itself, which needs the game's window library
fix: Sodium only works in the game: take it out of the server's mods folder.

name: real-world-duplicate-uid
description: Paper 1.21.1 where two worlds carry the same identity file
fix: Delete uid.dat in the copied world: it is what says which world it is.

name: real-worldgen-settings-deleted
description: Paper 26.2 whose world generation settings file was lost
fix: Restore that file from a backup: the server cannot start without it, and --safeMode does not help.

name: real-recipe-old-result-format
description: Paper 1.21.1 with a recipe written the way it was before 1.20.5
fix: In the result, write id instead of item: the game changed how an item stack is written in 1.20.5.

name: real-chunks-in-wrong-file
description: Paper 1.21.1 whose region file was copied under another name
fix: Those chunks do not belong to that file: the server moves them, which loses what was there.

name: real-velocity-support-without-secret
description: Paper 1.21.1 told to trust a Velocity proxy but given no secret

mutate.text:
proxies:
  velocity:
    enabled: true
    online-mode: false
    secret: ''

fix: Put the proxy's forwarding secret in proxies.velocity.secret, or turn Velocity support off.

name: real-rcon-without-password
description: Paper 1.21.1 with RCON turned on and no password: it never starts
fix: Set rcon.password: with an empty one, RCON does not start at all, which looks like a refused connection.

name: real-java-options-override
description: Paper 1.21.1 asked for 2 GB, while an environment variable quietly gives it 512 MB
fix: Remove the _JAVA_OPTIONS variable (Razer Synapse and other tools set it): it is applied after the command line and wins.

name: real-jar-not-there
description: A start command pointing at a server jar that is not in the folder
fix: The start command names a file that is not there: fix the jar name in the panel or the script.

name: real-same-plugin-twice
description: Paper 1.20.1 with the same plugin present under two names
fix: Delete one of the two copies: with both there, neither is loaded.

name: real-coreprotect-database-unreachable
description: Paper 1.21.1 where CoreProtect is pointed at a database that never answers

mutate.text:
use-mysql: true
table-prefix: co_
mysql-host: db.invalid.local
mysql-port: 3306
mysql-database: coreprotect
mysql-username: mc
mysql-password: secret

fix: Point CoreProtect at a database that answers, or set use-mysql: false; the server starting is no sign that it is logging.

name: real-luckperms-storage-unreachable
description: Paper 1.21.1 where LuckPerms says it started while its database never answered

mutate.text:
storage-method: MySQL
data:
  address: db.invalid.local
  database: luckperms
  username: mc
  password: secret
  pool-settings:
    maximum-pool-size: 4
    connection-timeout: 5000
  table-prefix: 'luckperms_'

fix: The database refused the connection: open it to this machine (bind-address, firewall, user host), or keep the default H2 storage.

name: real-config-keeps-an-old-block-name
description: Paper 1.21.1 whose anti-xray list still names a block from before the flattening

mutate.text:
anticheat:
  anti-xray:
    enabled: true
    engine-mode: 1
    hidden-blocks:
    - minecraft:lit_redstone_ore

fix: Nothing migrates these files: back up config/, let the server write fresh ones, then re-apply the settings by hand.

name: real-plugin-reads-the-version-as-1-8-8
description: Paper 26.2 with a GrimAC build whose shaded library cannot read the new version numbering
fix: Use a Grim build that ships packetevents 2.12.3 or later: the server is fine, the library inside the plugin is not.

name: real-one-bad-jar-stops-every-plugin
description: Paper 1.21 where a single plugin jar holds the same class twice, and no plugin loads at all
fix: Rebuild or remove that one jar: Paper rewrites every plugin before loading any, so one it cannot read blocks them all.

name: real-a-method-java-21-brought
description: Paper 1.20.4 on Java 17 with a plugin that calls a method Java 21 brought
fix: Run the server on Java 21, or use a build made for the Java in place: the method belongs to Java, not to the plugin.

name: real-ids-that-nothing-registered
description: Fabric 26.2 where one mod asks for biomes another one never registered, and the game blames your datapacks
fix: Tectonic 3.0.26 fixed it: the ids carry Terralith's name, but the mod asking for them was the other one.

name: real-world-back-from-a-newer-version
description: Paper 1.21.11 opening a world last used by a 26.1.2 server, which moved the generation settings elsewhere
fix: Put the newer version back, or restore a backup from before the move: going back is not supported and damages worlds.
